tasks.objective: Resolve concrete N44 blocker: private captureSourceMetadata exists but no trusted binding to actual mounted store/cloud/document. Root supported cua_repl can read existing Chrome Rakeez tab; CLI worker browser absence must not halt code preparation. Read actual private capture implementation and evidence at po-20261028-n44-browser-surface/observation.json, but never publish private custody code/secrets or import its Node module into frontend. Implement minimal explicit read-only diagnostic integration in teaching-hub and a new browser-safe notification-source-readiness module, using actual mounted store/cloud and existing Sync/notification/date helpers, not global injection or fabricated snapshots. A collapsed support diagnostic must bind a bounded original-custodian public challenge (public key, grant/task/run, expiry and approved owner/workspace hashes; no secrets), collect only selected teaching ancestry/revisions plus source IDs and Sync guards, encrypt locally for original custodian, and expose bounded downloadable receipt. No student names/scores/token/session material, telemetry or outbound requests for capture. No data/preference mutation, registration, source creation or send. Do not mark current desktop as an authorized phone: distinguish read-only capture device provenance from the two registered send recipients, preserve owner/workspace verification; report precise private-adapter compatibility delta needed before live use rather than weaken device checks. Default no capture until explicit challenge/action, reject malformed/expired/mismatched challenge, missing/replaced context, pending writes and invalid calendar. Minimize normal UI clutter within support disclosure. Reuse semantics of existing capture tests and implement focused browser-side tests including actual API signatures; no stand-in getX methods assumed without inspecting store. Original parent may perform actual UI readback using supported browser after publication. Produce usable source integration and instructions for original-custodian challenge generation and receipt admission, not another abstract adapter requiring absent ports. Any private producer changes belong subsequent original core task; report exact interface needed. No live grant consumption. Current midnight window missed unless all real requirements proven in time; do not fake time. Single source-only publisher; N44 remains OPEN.
